request.prompt: Instrumental gentle anime shipgirl battle theme with warm companionship and quiet bravery. Begin the clear main clarinet melody within the first two seconds; no uncertain wandering introduction. A simple singable eight-bar theme with four-bar rising question and four-bar falling answer, mostly stepwise notes and a few gentle thirds. Soft piano chord changes and light viola pulse quietly support one melodic lead. The clarinet finishes its phrase before a short mellow flute reply. Stable warm major harmony, regular graceful cadences, little ornamentation and moderate forward motion. Compact coherent structure over two minutes: direct theme statement, a closely related lyrical contrast, recognizable main-theme variations and a complete gentle return near the end. Avoid competing melodies, jittery piano runs, disjointed opening fragments, abrupt key changes, chromatic leaps, dense high strings and static pads. Entirely instrumental acoustic music: no singing, choir, speech, ocean ambience or weapon sounds. Clear one-at-a-time melodic lead, quiet supporting parts, comfortable middle registers and restrained dynamics.
